info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Corporate Action Review-spec
info.description: The Corporate Action Review Submission API enables financial institutions to submit reviews for corporate actions, ensuring that all actions are thoroughly evaluated and deemed appropriate. This endpoint allows users to send review requests associated with specific corporate actions identified by the parameter {param1}. Typical consumers include compliance teams and investment analysts who need to manage and document reviews for regulatory purposes or internal audits. Use this API to streamline the corporate action review process and enhance operational efficiency in market operations.

post.summary: Create a review for a corporate action.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified corporate action. Provide the necessary review details in the request body. Ensure that the corporate action ID is valid before submitting the review.

requestBody.description: Request body for submitting a review related to the corporate action identified by RES-100045. This body must contain all required fields as per the schema.
